SELECT
 _id
 FROM
 entries
 WHERE
 downloaded = 0 AND (
 read_state < 1 OR
 starred_state > 0 OR
 entries.type = 'N')

SELECT
 _id,
 SUM(read_freq+unread_freq) AS frequency,
 SUM(unread_freq) AS frequency,
 SUM(unread_freq) AS sum_unread_freq,
 ord
, feed_id
 
 FROM(
 SELECT
 'all articles' AS _id,
 -100 AS ord,
 COUNT(*) AS read_freq, 
 0 AS unread_freq
, -1 as feed_id
 
 FROM 
 entries
 ,entry_label_associations as elas,
 labels 
 
 WHERE 
 entries.read_state = 1
 AND entries.read_state < ?
 AND entries.starred_state > ?
 AND entries.friends_shared_state > ? 
 AND lower(labels.name) = ?
 AND entries._id = elas.entry_id
 AND elas.label_id = labels._id
 
 UNION

SELECT
 'all articles' AS _id,
 -100 AS ord,
 0 AS read_freq, 
 COUNT(*) AS unread_freq
, -1 as feed_id
 
 FROM 
 entries
 ,entry_label_associations as elas,
 labels 
 
 WHERE 
 entries.read_state < 1
 AND entries.read_state < ?
 AND entries.starred_state > ?
 AND entries.friends_shared_state > ? 
 AND lower(labels.name) = ?
 AND entries._id = elas.entry_id
 AND elas.label_id = labels._id
 

UNION

SELECT 
 lower(feeds.title) AS _id,
 0 AS ord, 
 COUNT(*) AS read_freq, 
 0 AS unread_freq
, feeds._id as feed_id
 
 FROM 
 entries, 
 feeds 
 ,entry_label_associations as elas,
 labels 

WHERE 
 entries.read_state = 1
 AND entries.read_state < ?
 AND feeds._id = entries.feed_id 
 AND entries.starred_state > ?
 AND entries.friends_shared_state > ? 
 AND lower(labels.name) = ?
 AND entries._id = elas.entry_id
 AND elas.label_id = labels._id

GROUP BY 
 feeds.title,
 feeds._id

UNION

SELECT 
 lower(feeds.title) AS _id,
 0 AS ord, 
 0 AS read_freq,

, feeds._id as feed_id
 
 FROM 
 entries, 
 feeds 
 ,entry_label_associations as elas,
 labels 

WHERE 
 entries.read_state < 1

 AND feeds._id = entries.feed_id

 AND elas.label_id = labels._id

GROUP BY 
 feeds.title, feeds._id)

 ord,
 _id,
 feed_id

SELECT
 _id AS _id,
 sum_freq AS frequency,
 sum_unread_freq,
 ord
 
 FROM
 dashboard_view 
 
 WHERE
 frequency > 0

SELECT
 _id AS _id,
 sum_unread_freq AS frequency,
 sum_unread_freq,
 ord
 
 FROM
 dashboard_view
 
 WHERE
 sum_unread_freq > 0

CREATE VIEW
 dashboard_view
 AS
 SELECT 
 _id,
 ord,
 SUM(read_freq) AS sum_read_freq,
 SUM(unread_freq) AS sum_unread_freq,
 SUM(read_freq+unread_freq) AS sum_freq
 
 FROM(
 
 SELECT
 lower(labels.name) AS _id,
 50 AS ord,
 COUNT(*) AS read_freq, 
 0 AS unread_freq
 
 FROM
 entries,
 entry_label_associations AS elas,
 labels
 
 WHERE
 entries.read_state = 1
 AND entries._id = elas.entry_id 
 AND elas.label_id = labels._id
 
 GROUP BY
 labels._id
 
 UNION
 
 SELECT
 lower(labels.name) AS _id,
 50 AS ord,
 0 AS read_freq, 
 COUNT(*) AS unread_freq
 
 FROM
 entries,
 entry_label_associations AS elas,
 labels
 
 WHERE
 entries.read_state < 1
 AND entries._id = elas.entry_id 
 AND elas.label_id = labels._id
 AND lower(labels.name) <> 'pinned'
 
 GROUP BY
 labels._id
 
 UNION
 
 SELECT
 'all articles' AS _id,
 -100 AS ord,
 COUNT(*) AS read_freq, 
 0 AS unread_freq
 
 FROM
 entries
 
 WHERE
 entries.read_state = 1
 
 UNION
 
 SELECT
 'all articles' AS _id,
 -100 AS ord,
 0 AS read_freq, 
 COUNT(*) AS unread_freq
 
 FROM
 entries
 
 WHERE
 entries.read_state < 1

UNION 
 
 SELECT
 'my recently starred' AS _id,
 -6 AS ord,
 COUNT(*) AS read_freq, 
 0 AS unread_freq
 
 FROM
 entries
 
 WHERE
 entries.starred_state = 1
 AND entries.read_state = 1
 
 UNION
 
 SELECT
 'my recently starred' AS _id,
 -6 AS ord,
 0 AS read_freq, 
 COUNT(*) AS unread_freq
 
 FROM
 entries
 
 WHERE
 entries.starred_state = 1
 AND entries.read_state < 1
 
 UNION
 
 SELECT
 'notes' AS _id,
 -8 AS ord,
 COUNT(*) AS read_freq, 
 0 AS unread_freq
 
 FROM
 entries
 
 WHERE
 entries.type = 'N'
 AND entries.read_state = 1
 
 UNION
 
 SELECT
 'notes' AS _id,
 -8 AS ord,
 0 AS read_freq, 
 COUNT(*) AS unread_freq
 
 FROM
 entries
 
 WHERE
 entries.type = 'N'
 AND entries.read_state < 0
 
 ) 
 
 GROUP BY
 ord,
 _id

CREATE VIEW
 entries_view
 AS
 SELECT
 entries._id AS _id,
 ENTRY_HASH,
 STORAGE_LOCATION,
 entries.ATOM_ID as ATOM_ID,
 ALTERNATE_URL,
 CONTENT,
 CONTENT_TYPE,
 CONTENT_URL,
 entries.TITLE AS TITLE,
 FEED_ID,
 READ_STATE,
 READ_STATE_PENDING,
 STARRED_STATE,
 STARRED_STATE_PENDING,
 SHARED_STATE,
 SHARED_STATE_PENDING,
 PINNED_STATE_PENDING,
 FRIENDS_SHARED_STATE,
 UPDATED_UTC,
 DOWNLOADED,
 ERROR,
 feeds.TITLE as FEED_TITLE, 
 DOWNLOAD_PREF, 
 DISPLAY_PREF,
 feeds.ATOM_ID as FEED_ATOM_ID,
 AUTHOR,
 feeds.JS_ENABLED AS JS_ENABLED,
 SHARED_BY_FRIEND,
 TYPE,
 NOTE,
 NOTE_SUBMITTED_STATE,
 NOTE_SHOULD_BE_SHARED,
 feeds.ALT_URL AS FEED_ALTERNATE_URL,
 LIKED_STATE,
 LIKED_STATE_PENDING,
 feeds.FTW_ENABLED AS FTW_ENABLED,
 SNIPPET
 FROM
 feeds,
 entries
 WHERE
 feeds._id = entries.feed_id
 ORDER BY
 entries.UPDATED_UTC DESC

UPDATE
 entries
 SET
 read_state = 1, 
 read_state_pending = read_state_pending * -1 + 1
 WHERE
 read_state = 0 AND
 INSERTED_AT > ? AND
 rowid IN 
 (SELECT 
 entries.rowid
 FROM 
 entries
 
 ,feeds
 
 ,entry_label_associations as elas,
 labels
 
 WHERE
 entries.read_state = 0
 AND entries.starred_state > ?
 AND entries.friends_shared_state > ? 
 
 AND feeds._id = entries.feed_id
 

AND feeds._id = ?
 
 AND feeds.NOTIFICATION > 0
 
 AND (lower(labels.name) = ? 
 AND entries._id = elas.ENTRY_ID AND elas.LABEL_ID = labels._id)
 
)

SELECT 
 entries._id,
 entries.ATOM_ID,
 entries.ALTERNATE_URL,
 entries.CONTENT,
 entries.CONTENT_TYPE,
 entries.CONTENT_URL,
 entries.TITLE,
 feeds.title as derived_feed_title,
 feeds.DOWNLOAD_PREF,
 feeds.DISPLAY_PREF,
 entries.FEED_ID,
 entries.READ_STATE,
 entries.READ_STATE_PENDING,
 entries.STARRED_STATE,
 entries.STARRED_STATE_PENDING,
 entries.LIKED_STATE,
 entries.LIKED_STATE_PENDING,
 entries.SHARED_STATE,
 entries.SHARED_STATE_PENDING,
 entries.PINNED_STATE_PENDING,
 entries.UPDATED_UTC,
 entries.DOWNLOADED,
 entries.ERROR
, entries.ENTRY_HASH,
 feeds.JS_ENABLED
, feeds.FTW_ENABLED
, entries.SHARED_BY_FRIEND
, entries.NOTE
, entries.SNIPPET
 FROM
 feeds,
 entries
 ,entry_label_associations as elas,
 labels
 WHERE
 read_state < ?
 AND entries.INSERTED_AT > ?
 AND feeds._id = entries.feed_id
 AND entries.starred_state > ?
 AND entries.friends_shared_state > ? 


 AND feeds._id = ?
 
 AND feeds.NOTIFICATION > 0
 
 AND (lower(labels.name) = ? 
 AND entries._id = elas.ENTRY_ID AND elas.LABEL_ID = labels._id)
 
 ORDER BY
 entries.UPDATED_UTC

UPDATE 
 entries
 SET
 read_state = 1
 WHERE
 entries.read_state = -1 AND
 NOT EXISTS(
 SELECT
 1 
 FROM
 temp_ids
 WHERE
 entries.atom_id = temp_ids.atom_id
 )
 AND read_state_pending = 0

UPDATE 
 entries
 SET
 read_state = 1
 WHERE
 entries.read_state = -1 AND
 NOT EXISTS(
 SELECT
 1 
 FROM
 temp_ids
 WHERE
 entries.entry_hash = temp_ids.atom_id
 )
 AND read_state_pending = 0

UPDATE 
 entries
 SET
 -STATE- = -SET-
 WHERE
 entries.-STATE- = -CLEAR- AND
 EXISTS(
 SELECT
 1 
 FROM
 temp_ids
 WHERE
 entries.atom_id = temp_ids.atom_id
 )
 AND -STATE_PENDING- = 0

UPDATE 
 entries
 SET
 -STATE- = -SET-
 WHERE
 entries.-STATE- = -CLEAR- AND
 EXISTS(
 SELECT
 1 
 FROM
 temp_ids
 WHERE
 entries.entry_hash = temp_ids.atom_id
 )
 AND -STATE_PENDING- = 0

DELETE 
 FROM
 temp_ids
 WHERE
 EXISTS(
 SELECT
 1 
 FROM
 entries
 WHERE
 entries.atom_id = temp_ids.atom_id
 )

DELETE 
 FROM
 temp_ids
 WHERE
 EXISTS(
 SELECT
 1 
 FROM
 entries
 WHERE
 entries.entry_hash = temp_ids.atom_id
 )

SELECT
 ATOM_ID 
 FROM
 temp_ids_READ_HASHES
 ORDER BY TIMESTAMP

SELECT
 _id,
 atom_id
 FROM
 entries
 WHERE
 read_state_pending = 0 AND
 starred_state_pending = 0 AND
 shared_state_pending = 0 AND
 liked_state_pending = 0 AND
 pinned_state_pending = 0 AND
 NOT (note_submitted_state = 0 AND note IS NOT null)
 AND read_state = 1
 
 AND (entries.atom_id NOT IN (
 SELECT
 e2.atom_id
 FROM
 entries e2
 WHERE
 e2.starred_state = 1
 ORDER BY
 e2.read_state ASC,
 e2.UPDATED_UTC DESC
 LIMIT ?)
 
 AND entries.atom_id NOT IN (
 SELECT
 e2.atom_id
 FROM
 entries e2
 WHERE
 e2.shared_state = 1
 ORDER BY
 e2.read_state ASC,
 e2.UPDATED_UTC DESC
 LIMIT ?)
 
 AND entries.atom_id NOT IN (
 SELECT
 e2.atom_id
 FROM
 entries e2
 WHERE
 e2.type = 'N'
 ORDER BY
 e2.read_state ASC,
 e2.UPDATED_UTC DESC
 LIMIT ?)
 
 AND entries.atom_id NOT IN (
 SELECT
 e2.atom_id
 FROM
 entries e2
 ORDER BY
 e2.UPDATED_UTC DESC
 LIMIT ?)
 )
 
 ORDER BY
 READ_STATE DESC,
 UPDATED_UTC ASC

DELETE 
 FROM
 entries
 WHERE
 type = 'N' 
 AND read_state_pending = 0 
 AND starred_state_pending = 0 
 AND shared_state_pending = 0 
 AND pinned_state_pending = 0 
 AND NOT (note_submitted_state = 0 AND note IS NOT null)
 AND NOT EXISTS(
 SELECT
 1 
 FROM
 temp_ids
 WHERE
 entries.atom_id = temp_ids.atom_id
 )
 AND read_state_pending = 0;
 DELETE
 FROM
 temp_ids
